step_text: Make sure the washer is not currently in a power interruption. Check whether lights or another appliance on the same electrical circuit are working.

step_text: If there is still no response, check the electrical outlet using a safe method. If you are not comfortable testing an outlet, have a qualified person verify that the outlet is supplying power.

dense_caption: A text card image displaying the instruction: 'If the outlet has no power, do not attempt to repair the household wiring yourself. Restore the household electrical supply or contact a qualified electrician.'.

step_text: If the outlet has power, disconnect the washer from the outlet before doing any further external inspection. Wait briefly, reconnect it securely, and press Power again.
